contract.sync_assumed: caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage by a block barrier
contract.sync_performed: __syncthreads inside: 2 per radix pass plus 1 init plus 3 in the pairs exchange epilogue
contract.k_range: [1, N) at run time, k == N returns the input unchanged
contract.n_range: N = 256 x IPT, IPT >= 1, measured 1024 to 32768 (the exchange buffer of N x 4 bytes is dynamic shared memory)
contract.type_constraints: fp32 and bf16 through the radix traits (fp16, fp64, fp8 have traits but are outside the focus set), int32 indices
contract.nan_behavior: NaN twiddles to the largest radix key and is selected first, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 is normalized to +0.0 for ranking and returned as the original key
contract.tie_break_support: not supported: ties at the k-th key are resolved by shared-memory atomic ticket order (not_guaranteed only). Knowledge base 4.5 describes the warp-redundant rank for prefer_smaller_index at about plus 1 percent
contract.sorted_output_support: not supported inherently, post-sort of k
